description: A family is completing several related legal forms and keeps getting confused about which names, dates, addresses, and supporting documents must stay consistent across all of them.

user_profile.persona: 45-year-old sibling coordinating paperwork for multiple family members
user_profile.context: Each form looks manageable on its own, but the overlap between them is causing repeated mistakes
user_profile.communication_style: Careful and cross-checking, wants consistency more than speed

fact_sheet.fact: The full legal name to be used for the family matriarch on all legal forms is 'Eleanor Vance Sinclair'.
Eleanor Vance Sinclair's date of birth, to be used for identity verification, is April 5, 1948.
The primary residential address to be listed consistently across all documents is '456 Oak Avenue, Meadowbrook, WA 98052'.
The full legal name for the family patriarch is 'Robert James Sinclair', born June 22, 1946.
Alex Morgan Sinclair is designated as the Primary Agent on the 'Durable Power of Attorney' document, Form DPA-112.
Brenda Chloe Sinclair is designated as the Successor Agent on Form DPA-112, to act only if Alex Morgan Sinclair is unable.
The 'Advance Healthcare Directive' is officially identified as Form HCD-7B.
On Form HCD-7B, Section 4, 'End-of-Life Decisions', requires the declarant to initial next to each of the three choices, not just check the box.
The 'Last Will and Testament' for Eleanor Vance Sinclair was drafted by Evergreen Law Group on August 1, 2024.
All signed and notarized documents must be mailed to 'Evergreen Law Group, Attn: Sinclair Estate, 789 Birch Street, Suite 200, Meadowbrook, WA 98052'.
The deadline for submitting the initial draft review of all forms is September 30, 2024.
The final notarized document package must be physically received by Evergreen Law Group no later than 5:00 PM on November 15, 2024.
A certified copy of Eleanor and Robert Sinclair's marriage certificate, issued by King County on July 10, 1971, is required as a supporting document.
A clear photocopy of the front and back of Alex Morgan Sinclair's current Washington State Driver's License (ID# SINCLEM890A2) must be attached to Form DPA-112.
All digital copies of supporting documents must be uploaded to the law firm's portal as PDF files, with a maximum size of 4MB per file.
The required file naming convention for uploads is 'LastName_FirstName_DocumentType_YYYYMMDD.pdf', for example, 'Sinclair_Eleanor_MarriageCert_20240905.pdf'.
The notary public scheduled for the signing appointment on October 10, 2024, is David Chen, whose commission number is 1234567 and expires on June 30, 2027.
The signing of the 'Last Will and Testament' requires two witnesses who are not family members, beneficiaries, or the named notary.
The primary paralegal contact at Evergreen Law Group is Ms. Jennifer Riley, reachable at j.riley@evergreenlaw.com.
The executor named in Robert James Sinclair's will is his brother, Michael David Sinclair.
The street name 'Oak Avenue' must be written out in full on all documents; do not use the abbreviation 'Oak Ave.'.
All dates entered on the forms must follow the MM/DD/YYYY format, for example, 09/15/2024.
Middle names or middle initials must be included on every signature line and printed name field to match government-issued identification.
Form DPA-112 requires the signature of the Principal (Eleanor Sinclair) on page 5 and the acceptance signature of the Agent (Alex Sinclair) on page 6.
The property deed for 456 Oak Avenue (Parcel ID: 3345-001-023) must be attached as 'Exhibit A' to the Sinclair Family Trust document.
The two non-family witnesses chosen for the will signing are neighbor Susan Davis and family friend Thomas Schmidt.
Alex Morgan Sinclair's current mailing address for all correspondence is '110 Pine Street, Apt 3B, River City, WA 98101'.
